notes.title: I announce to you that our new game Retrowave World will be released this year.
notes.content:
Dear Night Runners,

I announce to you that our new game Retrowave World will be released this year on Steam.
If you like Rampage Miami, you'll love Retrowave World.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2413050/Retrowave_World/

[previewyoutube=X2XLwMOLs18;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for all the support you give to Rampage Miami and thank you to those who will decide to support Retrowave World!

And remember, never stop driving under the endless sunset ːretrowaveː
